chunks: "The Eid al-Adha lasts for three days, and the best of them is its first day."

key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice

ai.seo_question: How many days does Eid al-Adha last, and which day is the most virtuous?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the period of al-Aḍḥā extends across three days. It also indicates that the first of these days holds the greatest virtue and superiority.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The Eid al-Adha (sacrifice) lasts for three days, and the first day is the most virtuous."
